lines.text: Hi Muhammad, I run a physiotherapy clinic in Lahore with twelve therapists.
Great to meet you Ayesha. What are you looking for?
We want to try your stroke game with our patients. Our budget is around two lakh rupees.
Let's do a demo next Tuesday at 3 pm at your clinic.
Perfect, and please send me the pricing sheet before that.

facts: send pricing sheet before the demo
traps: a specific price quoted by the founder

lines.text: Assalam o alaikum, main Karachi se hoon, angel investor hoon.
Wa alaikum assalam Bilal sahab, shukriya call karne ka.
Main pre-seed mein 50 hazaar dollar tak dekh raha hoon, pitch deck bhej dein.
Ji zaroor, main aaj shaam tak deck email kar doon ga, aap apni email de dein.
Email baad mein WhatsApp kar doon ga.

facts: founder sends the pitch deck by this evening
Bilal will share his email later

lines.text: میں پمز میں فزیو تھراپی ڈیپارٹمنٹ کی ہیڈ ہوں۔
بہت خوشی ہوئی، آپ کو کس چیز میں دلچسپی ہے؟
ہمیں مریضوں کی پراگریس ٹریکنگ چاہیے، ہمارے پاس روزانہ تقریباً اسی مریض آتے ہیں۔
ہم اگلے مہینے آپ کے ساتھ ایک پائلٹ شروع کر سکتے ہیں۔
ٹھیک ہے، لیکن پہلے ایتھکس کمیٹی کی منظوری لینی ہو گی۔

traps: a pilot start date with a specific day

lines.text: Sir main NUST mein biomedical engineering final year mein hoon.
Achha, aap ne Unity ya Python mein kaam kiya hai?
Python mein kaafi, Unity mein thora sa. Mera FYP EMG signals pe hai.
Theek hai, apna CV bhej dein, aur hum next week ek short interview karte hain.
I work with an NGO in Swat that supports flood-affected families.
Many older people there have mobility problems and there is no physiotherapist nearby.
Our phone-camera gait tool might help. Could community health workers use it?
Yes, we have about thirty health workers. We would need Pashto support though.
Pashto is possible. I will send you a short proposal by Friday.

facts: no physiotherapist nearby, older people with mobility problems
founder sends a proposal by Friday
traps: the tool already deployed in Swat
